interpretation: This gate separates first-action cockpit proof from the user's perceived long Documents concern. It does not claim the whole Documents page is short merely because the first risk-assessment action is visible.

allowed: Selected risk-assessment cockpit and first field/action surfaces are measured when per-state metrics pass.
Route split can help orientation when routeSplitVerdict is PASS_ORIENTATION_ONLY.
forbidden: Documents page is short based only on first-action cockpit visibility.
Full 12-document authoring IA is solved based only on selected risk-assessment cockpit proof.
Page count or route split alone fixes long-form document editing.

verdictModel.routeSplitVerdict: route/page split can pass for orientation but is not accepted as the length fix
verdictModel.firstActionCockpitVerdict: selected document header, field strip, evidence/recheck CTA, shell containment, sticky overlap 0, and no horizontal overflow
verdictModel.selectedEditorFieldFirstVerdict: risk row header and hazard field appear before raw textarea; row header carries evidence and verification context
verdictModel.sameDocumentReselectLandingVerdict: same risk document launcher/reselect settles inside one second with action row, first risk row header, and hazard field top before raw textarea; full field visibility remains covered by Field-first
verdictModel.allDocumentLongFormVerdict: RED if multiple document bodies/raw editors render serially or if all-12 launcher exposure pushes the selected editor action/hazard out of the viewport instead of staying bounded navigation
verdictModel.selectedEditorDepthVerdict: RED if the selected document editor shell exceeds 3 local screens or the bounded absolute target even though the first action is visible
verdictModel.overallDocumentsIAVerdict: PASS only when first-action cockpit, selected field-first editor, all-document containment, and selected-editor depth all pass
